description: This PHP source file defines the SmsClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It is used to interact with the AWS Server Migration Service, providing methods for various operations such as creating, deleting, and managing migration applications and jobs.

classes.name: SmsClient
classes.description: A client class used to send requests to AWS Server Migration Service, providing methods for managing migration apps, jobs, and configurations.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new migration application on AWS.

methods.name: createReplicationJob
methods.description: Starts a new replication job to migrate servers.

methods.name: deleteServerCatalog
methods.description: Deletes the server catalog stored in AWS.

methods.name: generateChangeSet
methods.description: Generates a change set for a migration.

methods.name: getApp
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific migration application.

methods.name: getAppLaunchConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the launch configuration for a migration app.

methods.name: getAppReplicationConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the replication configuration for an app.

methods.name: getAppValidationConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves validation configuration for an app.

methods.name: getAppValidationOutput
methods.description: Gets validation output for an application.

methods.name: getConnectors
methods.description: Lists connectors associated with AWS Server Migration Service.

methods.name: getReplicationRuns
methods.description: Lists replication runs for a specific job.

methods.name: getServers
methods.description: Retrieves servers associated with the service.

methods.name: notifyAppValidationOutput
methods.description: Notifies validation output for an application.

methods.name: putAppLaunchConfiguration
methods.description: Creates or updates the launch configuration for an app.

methods.name: putAppReplicationConfiguration
methods.description: Creates or updates the replication configuration.

methods.name: startOnDemandReplicationRun
methods.description: Starts a replication run on demand.

methods.name: updateReplicationJob
methods.description: Updates settings for a replication job.
